from.place: Exact native forgetting identifies the cohomology pair

title: Exact native forgetting identifies the cohomology pair
statement: For every native Weil complex K and integer n, its native cohomology sheaf, viewed as an ordinary Weil pair, is isomorphic to degree n cohomology of its ordinary derived Frobenius pair [def-sf-native-derived-pair-cohomology]. This includes the Frobenius actions, not only the underlying sheaves.

proof.text: The exact forgetful functor U has a canonical homology comparison. Show compatibility of homology comparisons with composition using the cycles and quotient universal properties on complexes and localization uniqueness. Apply naturality with respect to the structure isomorphism UF ~= U. The resulting identity is precisely the action-intertwining equation for the homology comparison. Lift that sheaf isomorphism through Algebra.isoMk and ObjectProperty.isoMk.
